result.note: Tests the summit venues, India's G7 status and the first Indian PM visit to Slovakia; one question for an Also in the news item.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's outreach to Europe in June 2026:
items: External Affairs Minister Jaishankar attended the 14th Kultaranta Talks, a foreign-policy forum hosted by Finland.
Prime Minister Modi was to attend the G7 Summit at Évian-les-Bains in France as a full member of the grouping.
Modi's Slovakia leg marks the first visit by an Indian Prime Minister to that country since its 1993 independence.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because India was to join the G7 Summit at Évian-les-Bains on 16 to 17 June 2026 as an invited partner, not as a member. The 13 to 18 June visit also included a bilateral meeting with President Macron and the launch of the "Bharat Innovates" event in Nice.
questions.source: The Slovakia leg marks the first visit by an Indian Prime Minister to the country since its 1993 independence.
